paper_title: Constraints on axionlike particles from a combined analysis of three flaring $\textit{Fermi}$ flat-spectrum radio quasars
notes: Combined analysis of three flaring Fermi FSRQs (3C454.3, CTA 102, 3C279) constraining ALP-photon coupling g_agamma. Exclusion stated as 5 neV < m_a < 200 neV and g_agamma > 5e-12 GeV^-1 at 95% CL. Detailed exclusion contours given in Figs 7-9 but only approximate corner values extractable from text.
